question_mapping.question_reference: How did the weight change that concerns you begin?
How often have well-planned diet or activity efforts produced less change than you expected?
After an intentional weight loss, how often has some or all of the weight returned?
How many meaningful cycles of weight loss and regain have you experienced?
On how many days per week do you complete intentional physical activity?
On active days, what is the usual duration of your intentional activity?
Which option best describes your usual physical activity pattern?
How many hours of sleep do you typically get in a 24-hour period?
How often do you feel tired even after what seemed like enough time in bed?
How often do you wake during the night and struggle to return to sleep?
How often is your bedtime after midnight?
How often do you remain awake until 2:00 AM or later because you cannot settle to sleep?
How often do you snore loudly, wake gasping, or receive feedback that your breathing pauses during sleep?
How often do you experience a marked afternoon energy crash?
How often do you feel physically hungry within two hours after a full meal?
How often do you experience food cravings when you are not physically hungry?
How often do you eat enough but still fail to feel comfortably full?
How often do you feel comfortably full after a normal meal?
How often are you hungry again three to four hours after a protein-rich meal?
How often does a protein-rich meal keep you satisfied for four hours or longer?
How often do you feel sleepy, foggy or low in energy after a main meal?
When you start eating sweets or snack foods, how often is it difficult to stop at the amount you intended?
How often do you feel persistent physical tension or stress?
How often does stress increase your desire to eat?
How often does your mind race when you are trying to sleep?
How often are cravings noticeably stronger in the evening?
How often do you experience bloating, gas or digestive discomfort?
How often do you experience brain fog after meals?
How often do you experience unexplained joint pain or stiffness?
How often does fat around your waist seem resistant to your usual efforts?
How often do you experience unusual thirst or a dry mouth?
How often have reducing calories and increasing activity produced little sustained change?
How often do you spend the first hour after waking indoors without natural daylight exposure?
How often do you use a phone, tablet or computer during the final hour before sleep?
How often do you eat within three hours of bedtime?
How often does your sleep schedule vary by more than two hours across the week?
How often do you feel more alert late at night than during the morning?
How often does your body seem to resist weight loss despite consistent effort?
How often does hunger feel stronger than your ability to regulate it?
How often are your energy levels lower than you believe they should be?
